verdict.rationale: Skyfire ships a documented public REST API (token creation, introspection, charge-token) plus API-key auth, confirmed live via runtime probe (NOT_AUTHORIZED challenge on keyless call), and an MCP server for agentic workflows, giving AI-native users multiple documented programmatic entry points. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on all probed paths) and no independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs and probes.
